title: Technical Recruiter (Contract)
description:
Summary
  
  
Do you have a passion for helping others succeed? Do you genuinely believe that talent is the greatest asset of any company? As a member of Apple’s People group, you’ll help discover and develop our most important resource: our people. Together, we’ll search the world to build our collective of talented perfectionists, visionaries, and inventors. All the while, your efforts will maintain Apple as the most innovative company by striving to make us the most diverse — open to all people, all backgrounds, and all perspectives. And that’s just the beginning, because throughout Apple employees’ careers, you will continue to help them grow professionally and support them in work and life. Join the team and help build and keep the extraordinary talent it takes to make extraordinary products. We are looking for an experienced Technical Recruiter / Engineering Recruiter to join our team in Hyderabad on a contract basis. This role is responsible for providing the highest level of recruiting partnership to Apple's business leaders and candidates through our sourcing and selection processes, performing full lifecycle recruitment while maintaining excellent relationships. You will have the opportunity to work with an amazing, robust, and agile team responsible for hiring world-class talent. Apple has an exciting, high-performance culture. If you are results-driven, a self-starter, and ready to "Think Different," come join us! In this pivotal role, you will be instrumental in identifying, attracting, and hiring top-tier technical talent across various high-demand domains. You will act as a strategic partner to our hiring managers, leveraging market intelligence and data-driven insights to build exceptional teams that drive our innovation and success. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, possess a keen eye for talent, and are dedicated to delivering an outstanding candidate experience, we encourage you to apply. This is a contract position.
  
  
Description
  
  
As a Corporate Recruiter, you will be the cornerstone of our technical hiring efforts, owning and driving the end-to-end recruitment process for critical engineering and product roles. Your responsibilities will include: Strategic Talent Sourcing: Proactively source, engage, and attract top-tier technical talent from diverse channels, employing creative and effective strategies to build robust pipelines. You'll be the go-to person for finding the right profiles. Full-Cycle Recruitment & Candidate Engagement: Manage the entire recruitment lifecycle from initial candidate engagement through offer negotiation and onboarding, ensuring a seamless, positive, and engaging experience for all candidates. Hiring Partner Alignment: Conduct comprehensive intake meetings with hiring managers and leaders to deeply understand hiring profiles, define success metrics, and collaboratively develop effective sourcing and hiring strategies. Market Intelligence & Advisory: Provide data-backed insights on talent market availability, competitive compensation trends, and hiring best practices to influence and guide strategic hiring decisions. Data Analysis & Process Improvement: Analyse key recruitment metrics (e.g., conversion rates, time-to-source, time-to-hire) to evaluate pipeline health, identify bottlenecks, and proactively suggest process enhancements and optimizations. ATS Management & Communication: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records within our Applicant Tracking System (ATS), ensuring smooth communication and efficient workflow throughout the recruitment journey. Special Projects & Initiatives: Actively participate in and contribute to various talent acquisition and people-related special projects, helping to shape and refine our overall recruiting strategies and employer brand. Continuous Learning: Stay current with industry trends, best practices, and innovative sourcing techniques to maintain a competitive edge in the talent market.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 3 years of full-cycle recruiting experience, with a strong preference for candidates who have worked within the Technology sector
* Have a well-developed network of candidates and/or the skills to build the network quickly and comprehensively

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Experience working in a global or rapidly scaling organisation.
* A passion for technology and staying abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and talent landscapes.
* Certifications in recruitment best practices or relevant recruiting tools.
* Experience with employer branding initiatives or talent marketing.
* Proven track record of successfully hiring for high-demand, specialised technical roles such as Software Engineering (Backend, Frontend, Full Stack), Product Management, Data Science, Machine Learning, or similar.
* Demonstrated ability to quickly ramp up, manage a high volume of requisitions, prioritise effectively, and operate autonomously to consistently hit challenging hiring targets.
* Excellent communication, influencing, and consultation skills, with a proven ability to build strong relationships and partner effectively with senior Hiring Managers and Leaders.
* Expertise in utilising Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and advanced proficiency with LinkedIn Recruiter for sourcing and engagement.

  
  
  

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.

Junior NON-IT RECRUITER – JOB DESCRIPTION

**Job description:**

Dr. Care Homeopathy Group , established in 2005 by Dr. A.M. Reddy, is a leading chain of homeopathy and Toot dental clinics across India. Renowned for its success in treatments, the group is dedicated to advancing homeopathy and has reached millions of people nationwide. With a strong focus on patient care and effective treatments, Dr.Care Homeopathy Group has established itself as a trusted healthcare provider. The organization is driven by an ethos of delivering high-quality care and achieving positive outcomes for patients.

**Designation:** Senior Recruiter – Non-IT Recruitment  
**Department:** Human Resources – Talent Acquisition  
**Experience:** 4+ Years  
**Industry:** Healthcare / Hospitals / Corporate  
**Salary: 4LPA- 7LPA**  
**Work Location: JNTU,** HYDERABAD.  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Senior Recruiter with 4+ years of expertise in Non-IT recruitment to manage end-to-end hiring for healthcare, corporate, and operational roles. The ideal candidate should have strong sourcing, screening, interview coordination, and candidate management skills.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage end-to-end Non-IT recruitment, from sourcing to onboarding.
* Handle recruitment for healthcare professionals, doctors, dentists, call center executives, front-office staff, and corporate positions.
* Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, job portals, employee referrals, and other recruitment channels.
* Screen resumes, conduct initial HR discussions, and evaluate candidate suitability.
* Coordinate interviews with hiring managers and department heads.
* Maintain recruitment trackers, candidate databases, and daily hiring reports.
* Ensure timely closure of vacancies and achievement of recruitment targets.
* Negotiate salary expectations and manage offer releases and follow-ups.
* Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for current and future hiring requirements.
* Follow up with selected candidates until joining and reduce offer dropouts.

Required Skills

* Strong expertise in Non-IT recruitment and talent acquisition.
* Excellent sourcing, screening, and negotiation skills.
* Experience using Naukri, LinkedIn, and other job portals.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple vacancies and meet hiring deadlines.
* Good knowledge of recruitment metrics, MIS reporting, and candidate management.

Eligibility Criteria

* Any graduate or postgraduate qualification in HR or a related field.
* Minimum 4 years of relevant Non-IT recruitment experience.
* Experience in bulk hiring, healthcare recruitment, or corporate hiring is preferred.
* Immediate joiners or candidates with a short notice period are preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Monthly vacancy closure targets.
* Time-to-hire and quality of hire.
* Interview-to-selection and offer-to-joining ratios.
* Candidate follow-up and joining conversion rates.
* Hiring manager satisfaction and recruitment reporting accuracy.

**Interested individual can share their updated resume to 7337550168(What's App)**

**Regards**

**Praveen HR**

**Toot Dental/ Dr Care Homeopathy**

**7337550168**

* Full-cycle recruitment: 4 years (Preferred)

**Position:** Talent Acquisition Executive  
**Company:** Assettrust Services Pvt. Ltd.  
**Department:** Human Resources  
**Location:** 1st floor,Gafoornagar vittal rao nagar, madhapNoveltech Trendz Hubur 500081  
**Experience:** 1–4 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Working Days:** 6 Days a Week  
**Week Off:** Monday  
**Working Hours:** 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM  
**Joining:** Immediate Joiners Preferred

About Assettrust Services

Assettrust Services is a growing name in the real estate industry, established in 2014. We are committed to delivering excellence through our core values of Trust, Transparency and Expertise.

Role Overview

We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented Talent Acquisition Executive to manage end-to-end recruitment activities. The ideal candidate should have strong sourcing skills, the ability to handle multiple requirements, and experience in hiring for sales and non-sales positions.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage the complete end-to-end recruitment lifecycle, from sourcing to onboarding.
* Understand hiring requirements and job specifications from department heads and hiring managers.
* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, social media and other recruitment channels.
* Screen resumes, conduct initial telephonic interviews and evaluate candidate suitability.
* Coordinate and schedule interviews with hiring managers and ensure timely feedback.
* Manage candidate follow-ups and maintain a healthy recruitment pipeline.
* Drive bulk and volume hiring for sales and business development roles.
* Ensure timely closure of open positions within defined hiring timelines.
* Maintain daily recruitment trackers, interview reports and MIS.
* Conduct pre-joining follow-ups to minimize candidate dropouts.
* Coordinate with HR Operations for smooth joining and onboarding.
* Build and maintain a strong database of potential candidates.

Required Skills & Competencies

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good understanding of recruitment processes and sourcing strategies.
* Hands-on experience with job portals and LinkedIn recruitment.
* Ability to manage multiple vacancies simultaneously.
* Strong negotiation, follow-up and candidate engagement skills.
* Target-oriented approach with a focus on timely closures.
* Good coordination and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and recruitment trackers.

Preferred Experience

* Experience in Real Estate, Financial Services, Ban

description:
**We're looking for a**

**Director, Talent Acquisition - India**
========================================

**This role is** **Office Based, India**

India is Cornerstone’s largest and fastest-growing talent market and has become a critical talent hub for our global business. With offices in Pune, Hyderabad, and Mumbai, and teams representing every area of the company, India plays an increasingly important role in how we build the capabilities needed to grow and evolve our business.

We are looking for a Director, Talent Acquisition – India to lead our recruiting organization across the region and help shape the next chapter of our India talent strategy.

This is much more than a recruiting operations role. We are looking for a leader who can transform Talent Acquisition into a highly strategic, technology-enabled function that helps the business make better talent decisions, access new talent pools, scale quickly when demand increases, and consistently attract exceptional talent.

You will lead a talented team of recruiters supporting both technical and non-technical hiring while serving as a trusted advisor to senior leaders across India and globally. The right person will combine strategic thinking with a strong bias for action — someone who is comfortable challenging conventional thinking while also rolling up their sleeves to find practical ways to make things happen.

**In this role you will....**

* Lead Talent Acquisition across India, developing and executing a recruiting strategy that supports one of Cornerstone's largest and most strategically important talent markets.
* Lead, develop, and inspire a high-performing team of recruiters supporting a diverse portfolio of technical and non-technical hiring across multiple functions and levels.
* Evolve the India TA organization from a primarily transactional recruiting function into a strategic talent advisory team that brings market intelligence, data, insights, and creative solutions to business leaders.
* Partner closely with executives, business leaders, People Business Partners, and other HR leaders to understand workforce priorities and translate them into effective talent strategies.
* Build strong relationships with India leadership and become a trusted advisor who can challenge assumptions, push back constructively, and offer alternative solutions while maintaining a collaborative, solutions-oriented approach.
* Develop flexible recruiting models that allow Cornerstone to scale hiring capacity up or down quickly during periods of increased demand without sacrificing candidate quality or experience.
* Use technology, automation, AI, data, and analytics to improve recruiting processes and create better experiences for candidates, hiring managers, and recruiters.
* Identify opportunities to simplify recruiting processes, eliminate unnecessary administrative work, and allow recruiters to spend more time advising the business and engaging talent.
* Build recruiting strategies that improve time to hire and quality of hire while maintaining a high bar for candidate and hiring-manager experience.
* Bring deep knowledge of the India talent market and use external market intelligence to help leaders understand talent availability, competitive dynamics, compensation trends, location strategies, and alternative talent pools.
* Lead and personally support executive and senior-level searches in India when needed, including talent mapping, market outreach, candidate assessment, and executive stakeholder management.
* Establish meaningful recruiting metrics and operating rhythms that provide visibility into performance, identify challenges early, and drive continuous improvement.
* Partner across HR to improve broader people processes and ensure recruiting connects effectively with workforce planning, onboarding, internal mobility, talent management, and the overall employee experience.
* Experiment with new recruiting approaches, technologies, partnerships, and talent sources that can help Cornerstone compete more effectively for talent across India.
* Build a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the India Talent Acquisition team.

**You've got what it takes if you have...**

* 8+ years of Talent Acquisition leadership experience within India, ideally supporting a large, global technology or multinational organization.
* Proven experience leading and developing high-performing recruiting teams across both technical and non-technical functions.
* A strategic talent leader who understands that great recruiting goes beyond filling requisitions and can demonstrate how TA can influence workforce and business decisions.
* Strong knowledge of the India technology and professional talent markets, including experience recruiting across major talent hubs.
* Demonstrated ability to build recruiting models and strategies that can scale rapidly during periods of high hiring demand.
* Strong executive presence with the ability to influence senior leaders, navigate competing priorities, and constructively challenge stakeholders when appropriate.
* A highly collaborative, solutions-oriented mindset — someone who doesn't stop at identifying why something cannot be done but works with partners to determine how we can make it work.
* Strong technical aptitude and genuine curiosity about how AI, automation, recruiting technology, and data can improve the way talent organizations operate.
* Experience using recruiting analytics and market intelligence to identify opportunities, influence decisions, and improve recruiting outcomes.
* Experience leading or personally executing executive-level searches in the India market.
* Strong understanding of recruiting operations, processes, systems, and candidate experience.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through change and transform recruiting teams, processes, or operating models.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder-management, and relationship-building skills with the ability to work effectively across India and global teams.

**Our Culture:**

Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.

**Who We Are:**

At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.

Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach have set us apart for 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world.
  
Arup Digital Products (ADP) develops and commercialises specialist engineering software globally. Our ambition is to become a commercially robust software business that turns Arup’s trusted expertise into scalable products that provides strategic value for the firm. As ADP diversifies across products, markets and regions, we need connected customer and revenue journeys, trusted data and systems that combine global consistency with appropriate local flexibility.
  
We are seeking an experienced Senior Revenue Operations Manager to build and lead a scalable revenue-operations capability for our growing multi-product, international software business.

  

**2. The Opportunity**
  
This role will build the revenue operations backbone for ADP’s next phase of growth. You will own the systems, data and operating processes that support the customer-to-revenue lifecycle, helping ADP scale new products, commercial models and markets with greater consistency and control.
  
You will own the development roadmap for Dynamics 365, HubSpot and any other key commercial operations systems for ADP. Our Dynamics platform extends beyond conventional CRM to support product and pricing data, quoting, order and licence delivery records, invoice preparation, royalty reporting and customer support. You will lead the developers and delivery partners who maintain and improve this environment.
  
Working across Sales, Marketing, Product, Software Engineering, Customer Support and Success, Customer Operations, Finance and Digital Technology, you will translate agreed pricing, product, licensing and go-to-market decisions into scalable systems, data, workflows and controls.
  
The role sits within ADP’s Operations Function. Reporting to ADP’s Global Commercial Manager, you will work cross-functionally across the global business and manage the India-based CRM development team, specialist technology suppliers and relevant Arup Digital Technology stakeholders.
  
You will use AI, automation and workflow technology to simplify work, improve data quality and reduce cost,.
  
You will shape a business-led revenue systems roadmap, strengthening ownership of commercial data and determining how Dynamics, HubSpot, licensing tools and wider Arup platforms should work together. This will include representing ADP’s requirements in any future integration between Dynamics and Arup’s wider commercial systems.
  
Your principal responsibilities will include:
  

* Own the development roadmap and governance for Dynamics 365, HubSpot, licensing tools and connected revenue systems, aligning investment and delivery priorities with ADP’s product pipeline and growth plans.
* Lead ADP’s in-house D365 CRM developers, HubSpot consultants and technology partners, setting priorities, requirements, delivery standards, testing, documentation, releases and user support arrangements.
* Own HubSpot as ADP’s top-of-funnel platform, governing lead capture, quality, lifecycle stages and hand-off to Dynamics.

* Lead revenue operations improvements with an aim to increase robustness to handle multiple product portfolios across multiple regions. Improvement aspects in both processes and revenue data quality & definitions.
* Enable functional leads to establish clear data ownership, governance and quality standards across the commercial lifecycle.
* Partner with functional leaders to translate agreed pricing, product configurations, licensing models and go-to-market decisions into scalable operating systems and processes.
* Establish the system controls, data and reporting processes required to support reliable commercial and financial reporting, including sales commission calculations, working closely with Finance and other functional owners and supporting relevant audit coordination.
* Enable Finance and Sales to operate effective forecasting processes through appropriate systems, data, controls and governance.
* Drive system adoption through appropriate technology training, onboarding, SOPs, in-system guidance and maintained knowledge content.
* Implement AI and automation where appropriate and remove inefficient processes and controls.

As ADP expands its portfolio, markets and revenue, you will build a global Revenue Operations capability that combines software-business agility with Arup’s expertise. This is a unique opportunity to create the operating infrastructure through which ADP takes products to market, processes revenue and supports customers.
  
Success in the role will be demonstrated through outcomes including:
  

* clear ownership and an effective development roadmap for ADP’s revenue and commercial systems;
* strong adoption of Dynamics, HubSpot and other business systems, supported by effective leadership of developers, consultants and suppliers;
* agreed product, pricing, licensing and go-to-market decisions translated effectively into scalable operating systems and processes;
* well-governed commercial data, effective system controls and reliable reporting that support operational and financial decision-making;
* more consistent and scalable customer-to-revenue processes across products, markets and functional teams;
* measurable improvements in efficiency, data quality and user experience across business systems and processes;
* targeted use of AI and automation delivering evidenced productivity, quality or cost benefits;
* overall, a revenue systems capability that can support new products, regions and commercial models without avoidable complexity.

At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas.

**3. Is this role right for you?**
  
This role is part of Arup Digital Products. We are seeking a senior Revenue Operations manager who can set direction, remain close to delivery and build scalable operating capability in a growing, multi-product software business. You should bring:
  

* Around 10 years or more relevant experience, including several years leading Revenue Operations, Commercial Operations or Business Systems within a rapidly growing B2B software, SaaS or technology business.
* Ownership of Dynamics 365 or a comparable enterprise CRM, together with HubSpot or similar marketing-automation technology, including platform roadmaps, governance and adoption.
* A track record of leading revenue systems transformation.
* Experience translating pricing, product, licensing and go-to-market decisions into scalable systems, data, workflows and controls across the customer-to-revenue lifecycle.
* Experience leading CRM developers, consultants or technical teams, ideally distributed globally, including setting development priorities and overseeing requirements, testing, releases, support and integration delivery.
* Practical experience improving commercial data, pipeline management, forecasting, reporting and governance in close partnership with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Product and Operations.
* Evidence of delivering automation, workflow or AI initiatives with measurable operational benefits.
* Experience building scalable operating processes in an agile, fast-moving environment.

You will be comfortable working across functions, geographies and time zones, with sufficient overlap with colleagues in Japan and the United Kingdom and close collaboration with India-based teams. You will combine strategic perspective with a hands-on approach to systems, data, processes and users.
  
You should distinguish technology issues from underlying process, ownership, data and capability gaps; challenge unclear requirements constructively; and deliver practical solutions suited to ADP’s scale and maturity.
  
Experience of software licensing, subscription or usage-based commercial models, product and pricing data, finance system integration, customer support platforms, engineering software or distributor channels would be advantageous but is not essential.

**4. What we offer you**
  
At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.
  
Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.
  
We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts.
  
India-specific details of rewards and benefits will be provided as part of the recruitment process.

  

**5. Different people, shared values**
  
Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age within legal limits, gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence.
  
Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Applications will be reviewed against the essential experience and capabilities set out above. Final-stage candidates may meet cross-functional senior stakeholders from Business Operations, Customer Operations and other relevant ADP functions.

* Good working knowledge of BIM/CAD software packages

----------------------------

As a Software Engineer on GitLab's Authorization team, you'll help build and maintain the system that decides what every user, token, and automated agent can access on GitLab.com, Self-Managed, and Dedicated. You'll work alongside experienced engineers who guide the larger design decisions, delivering well-scoped changes and growing into ownership of larger parts of the system.

Today, that work is Ruby on Rails. Roughly 400 policy classes and a catalog of about 1,900 permissions sit behind every application programming interface (API) request. You'll work on fine-grained token permissions, custom roles, and the GraphQL and representational state transfer (REST) APIs that enforce them. A single request can trigger hundreds of permission checks, so correctness and performance both matter.

You'll also contribute to moving the permission model to a new authorization stack that pairs the Rails monolith with a Rust policy engine. The engine represents access relationships and evaluates permission rules, and can run within the monolith's process or be reached through remote procedure calls using gRPC. You don't need prior Rust experience: several engineers on the team learned it for this work, and we'll support you doing the same.

Some examples of our projects:

* Refactoring GitLab's policy layer so the same permission definitions can be evaluated by the monolith and the new authorization service
* Extending fine-grained token permissions to more resources, with guidance from senior engineers on the design

* Implement authorization changes in GitLab's Ruby on Rails monolith so permission checks allow intended access and deny unauthorized access.
* Deliver well-scoped workstreams from feature-flagged rollout through verifying that the old and new systems produce the same results, with review and guidance from senior engineers.
* Build and extend fine-grained permissions for tokens and roles so additional resources have permission coverage consistent with the established catalog.
* Extend and fix authorization enforcement so GraphQL and the REST API enforce the intended permissions consistently.
* Make incremental refactors to long-lived policy code without changing behavior for existing customers.
* Investigate and fix reliability, performance, and security issues so affected permission checks return the expected results without regressions.
* Work with the authentication, platform, and artificial intelligence (AI) teams to document interface contracts that keep permission checks consistent as authorization moves toward a shared service.

* Familiarity with GraphQL or API authorization patterns.
* Awareness of performance, including how repeated permission checks can add up on every request.
* Strong written communication and the ability to work effectively when most decisions happen in a document or merge request rather than a meeting.
* Helpful, but not required: hands-on PostgreSQL experience, or experience with Rust, gRPC or Protocol Buffers, Cedar or other policy languages, Zanzibar-style authorization systems, Go, or service-oriented architecture.

**About AML RightSource**

We are AML RightSource, the leading technology-enabled managed services firm focused on fighting financial crime for our clients and the world. Globally, our staff of more than 4,000 highly trained analysts and subject matter experts is the industry's largest group of full-time compliance professionals. Together with our clients, we are Reimagining Compliance.

**About the Position**

We are seeking an experienced Learning and Development Manager to lead the strategy, operations, and continuous improvement of the Ready for Allocation (RFA) function in India.

The RFA group includes employees awaiting assignment to a client-focused team, typically after completing new-hire training or while transitioning between client engagements. It may also include employees on the bench awaiting project allocation in accordance with company policies.

The L&D Manager, RFA will be accountable for ensuring that employees within RFA remain skilled, engaged, professional, compliant, and ready for timely deployment. The role will oversee workforce-readiness planning, learning-needs identification, upskilling interventions, operational governance, stakeholder coordination, and the overall RFA employee experience.

This position will manage the L&D Coordinator responsible for day-to-day RFA operations and will work closely with Talent Development, Resourcing, HR, Workforce Management, Operations, and business stakeholders. The manager will use workforce data and business requirements to strengthen deployment readiness, reduce skill gaps, improve operational efficiency, and build a scalable RFA operating model.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **RFA Strategy and Governance**

* Define and drive the overall RFA workforce-readiness strategy in alignment with business, resourcing, and talent priorities.
* Establish clear operating standards, governance mechanisms, escalation paths, and accountability measures for the RFA population.
* Translate organizational policies into clear and practical RFA processes, guidelines, and employee expectations.
* Monitor the health and effectiveness of the RFA model and recommend changes based on workforce data, stakeholder feedback, and evolving business needs.
* Ensure consistency in the management of employees completing training, transitioning between client teams, or awaiting project allocation.

### **Workforce Readiness and Deployment Enablement**

* Oversee the readiness assessment of employees within RFA and ensure that skills, development needs, availability, and deployment status are accurately tracked.
* Partner with Resourcing, HR, Operations, and business leaders to understand upcoming talent requirements and prepare RFA employees for suitable opportunities.
* Identify barriers affecting employee deployment and coordinate appropriate learning, operational, or stakeholder interventions.
* Introduce structured readiness for employees to prepare for client project allocation.
* Provide leadership with timely visibility into workforce readiness, skill availability, development priorities, and deployment risks.

### **Learning Needs and Upskilling**

* Lead training-needs analysis for the RFA population using readiness data, business requirements, performance indicators, and stakeholder inputs.
* Design and oversee targeted upskilling pathways that keep employees client-ready while they await allocation.
* Prioritize learning interventions based on business demand, skill gaps, deployment opportunities, and employee readiness.
* Guide the creation of just-in-time learning resources to address immediate RFA concerns and emerging capability requirements.
* Evaluate the relevance and effectiveness of learning interventions and use findings to improve future programs.
* Collaborate with Talent Development colleagues and subject-matter experts to source, create, or facilitate appropriate learning solutions.

### **Data, Reporting, and Business Insights**

* Develop and maintain meaningful RFA dashboards, reports, and management insights.
* Analyze RFA data to identify skill gaps, readiness trends, allocation barriers, operational risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Define and monitor relevant measures for readiness, learning participation, skill development, deployment enablement, compliance, and employee engagement.
* Convert operational data into clear recommendations and decision support for senior stakeholders.
* Ensure data quality and consistency across RFA trackers, reporting tools, and HR systems.
* Use insights to prioritize interventions and demonstrate the business impact of the RFA function.

### **Team Leadership and Capability Development**

* Manage, coach, and develop the L&D Coordinator supporting RFA operations and enablement.
* Set clear priorities, performance expectations, and development goals for the coordinator.
* Review the quality and timeliness of readiness tracking, stakeholder communication, learning interventions, and RFA engagement activities.
* Delegate operational responsibilities while maintaining accountability for overall RFA outcomes.
* Build the coordinator’s capability in data analysis, stakeholder management, learning-needs analysis, facilitation, process improvement, and project execution.
* Create a collaborative, accountable, and improvement-oriented team environment.

### **Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary Talent Development point of contact for RFA readiness and capability development.
* Build strong relationships with HR, Resourcing, Workforce Management, Operations, client-facing teams, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Facilitate regular stakeholder reviews to discuss RFA status, deployment priorities, emerging skill requirements, risks, and required actions.
* Clarify ownership across teams and ensure timely follow-through on agreed actions.
* Escalate critical readiness, conduct, compliance, or deployment concerns through the appropriate channels.
* Communicate RFA priorities, expectations, risks, and progress clearly to employees and leadership.

### **Employee Experience, Professionalism, and Compliance**

* Create a structured and constructive experience for employees while they await allocation.
* Ensure employees understand the expectations associated with RFA, including availability, participation, learning completion, professional conduct, and communication.
* Oversee engagement initiatives that promote accountability, continuous learning, and connection to the organization.
* Work with HR and relevant stakeholders to manage recurring concerns related to participation, professionalism, conduct, or compliance.
* Ensure that RFA sessions and communications reinforce applicable company policies and workplace expectations.

### **Process Improvement and Automation**

* Review existing RFA processes to identify inefficiencies, duplication, manual work, and control gaps.
* Lead improvement initiatives that simplify workflows, strengthen accountability, and improve the accuracy and timeliness of information.
* Identify opportunities to automate recurring tracking, reporting, reminders, communications, and administrative activities.

* Establish standard operating procedures and appropriate documentation for critical RFA processes.
* Encourage the responsible use of technology and AI-enabled solutions to improve scalability and employee support.

* Relevant experience in Learning and Development, workforce readiness, talent operations, workforce management, or a related function.
* Experience leading people, projects, programs, or a significant operational workstream.

We are seeking a delivery-focused Senior Maritime Civil & Structural Engineer to assist with leading the design and technical delivery of maritime infrastructure projects, combining strong engineering fundamentals with the practical judgement needed to produce safe, buildable and efficient solutions.

  

The successful candidate will play a key role in the planning, assessment, design and delivery of maritime infrastructure projects across Scotland and the UK. Typical projects include ferry terminals, piers, jetties, quay structures, dolphins, linkspan support structures, slipways, seawalls and associated landside infrastructure such as pavements, drainage and utilities.

  

The role offers involvement across the full project lifecycle, from feasibility studies, optioneering and outline design through to detailed design, construction support and asset management. Projects range from the maintenance, rehabilitation and upgrade of existing assets through to major capital investment programmes.

  

We are seeking a delivery-focused engineer who combines strong technical skills with the ability to efficiently produce practical, high-quality engineering outputs. The successful candidate will combine strong technical capability with sound engineering judgement, developing solutions that are safe, buildable, maintainable and commercially aware.

* Develop practical, buildable and maintainable engineering solutions that meet client, operational and commercial requirements.
* Contribute to technical excellence, innovation and knowledge sharing across the maritime team.

### **Candidate Specification**

We are seeking a practical, technically capable and collaborative maritime engineer who is comfortable taking ownership of elements of technical delivery within multidisciplinary project teams.

  

The successful candidate will demonstrate sound engineering judgement and a pragmatic approach to problem solving. Whilst a strong analytical capability is required, we are seeking an engineer who can apply technical knowledge effectively to develop practical, proportionate and buildable solutions.

* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering or a related discipline.
* Master's degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Maritime Engineering or a related field.
* Typically 8+ years' relevant experience in the design and delivery of maritime structures.

* Experience in the design, assessment, rehabilitation and upgrade of maritime structures, including piled marine structures.

* Proven experience in the design of reinforced concrete, steel and pile-supported structures in marine environments.
